To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

we propose a new method for forecasting hierarchically-structured data, which is based on independently predicting all series at all hierarchical levels and then combining and reconciling these forecasts using a regression model.

(i) we propose a new method for hierarchical forecasting that is optimal in the sense that it has minimum variance amongst all possible combination forecasts; (ii) our method performs well in a simulation study compared to the top-down and bottom-up approaches; and (iii) we demonstrate our method on Australian tourism data, showing that our approach is able to provide better forecasts than the top-down approach, and is able to reconcile the forecasts of the bottom-up approach.
